instruction: Gehu mein pila pan aa raha hai kya karoon
output: Gehu mein pila pan zinc ya nitrogen ki kami se hota hai. Zinc sulphate 25 kg/hectare daalo aur urea ka chhidkav karo.

instruction: PM-KISAN yojana mein register kaise karein
output: PM-KISAN mein 6000 rupaye/year milte hain. pmkisan.gov.in par jaao ya CSC center par register karo. Aadhar + bank passbook + khasra chahiye.

instruction: Chawal mein blast disease ka ilaj batao
output: Tricyclazole 75% WP 0.6g/litre spray karo. Kheton mein paani ka level sahi rakho. Resistant varieties use karo jaise Pusa Basmati.

instruction: Drip aur flood irrigation mein kya fark hai
output: Drip irrigation mein 40-50% paani bachta hai. Sabzi aur baagan ke liye drip behtar hai. Flood irrigation sasta hai lekin paani zyada lagta hai.
Tamatar ke liye NPK 19:19:19 use karo. Calcium nitrate bhi faaydemand hai phal quality ke liye.
